about.title: Institut Supérieur de Commerce de Mbujimayi
about.subtitle: For over 30 years, ISC Mbujimayi has trained the professionals who shape the economy of Kasaï-Oriental and the Democratic Republic of Congo.
about.mission_p1: The Institut Supérieur de Commerce de Mbujimayi (ISC Mbujimayi) is a public higher education institution located in Mbujimayi, the capital of Kasaï-Oriental province, in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
about.mission_p2: Our mission is to train highly qualified professionals in the fields of commerce, management, IT and finance, capable of actively contributing to the socio-economic development of the country.
about.mission_p3: Through innovative pedagogy and strategic partnerships, we provide our students with the tools needed to succeed in an ever-changing professional world.
about.value_excellence_desc: We train competent professionals adapted to the economic realities of the DRC and the world.
about.value_innovation_desc: Our modern teaching methods combine theory and practice for optimal learning.
about.value_community_desc: A dynamic student community, supported by an experienced and dedicated faculty.
about.value_recognition_desc: Institution accredited by the Government of the Democratic Republic of Congo, issuing recognized diplomas.

news.title: News & Announcements
news.subtitle: Stay informed about the latest news from ISC Mbujimayi.
news.article_1_summary: ISC Mbujimayi announces the official opening of registrations for the 2024-2025 academic year. Files can be submitted online or at the secretariat.
news.article_1_content: To register, students must provide their State diploma, an identity photo and a copy of their national ID. Registrations are open from September 1 to November 30, 2024. Registration fees apply depending on the chosen program.
news.article_2_summary: The end-of-first-semester exam schedule is now available. Check your dashboard to see the dates for your program.
news.article_2_content: First semester exams will take place from December 15 to 30, 2024. Each student can consult their personalized schedule from their dashboard. Unjustified absences will result in penalties.
news.article_3_summary: ISC Mbujimayi is organizing an international conference on entrepreneurship and economic innovation in the DRC. Free registration for students.
news.article_3_content: The conference will be held on October 25, 2024 in ISC's multipurpose room. High-level speakers from the private sector and public institutions will share their experiences. Registration via the platform is mandatory.
news.article_4_title: Launch of the ISC E-Learning Platform
news.article_4_summary: The ISC Mbujimayi digital platform is officially launched. Access your courses, assessments and educational resources online, 24/7.
news.article_4_content: The e-learning platform allows each student to access video courses, submit assignments and track their progress. It is accessible on mobile and computer. An introductory training is available in the help section.
news.article_5_summary: The winners of the 2023-2024 academic excellence contest were honored at an official ceremony. Congratulations to the distinguished students!
news.article_5_content: Three students received the Très Grande Distinction mention at the ceremony on August 30, 2024. Their final research papers have been selected as academic references for the coming year.
news.article_6_summary: ISC Mbujimayi signs partnership agreements with several regional companies to promote the professional integration of its graduates.
news.article_6_content: These partnerships will allow students to benefit from internships from their second year onward. Partner companies also participate in dissertation juries and applied research projects.
news.article_7_summary: The annual cultural week will be held from November 18 to 22. On the program: exhibitions, debates, artistic competitions and gala evening.
news.article_7_content: Cultural week is a highlight of student life at ISC. This year it includes a photographic exhibition on the institution's history, idea debates and an awards ceremony.
news.article_8_summary: The ISC Mbujimayi internal regulations have been updated for the 2024-2025 academic year. All students are invited to read them.
news.article_8_content: The new internal regulations specify attendance rules, assessment procedures and disciplinary processes. They are available for download in the platform's document area.
